config.expected_if_false: In at least one seed, the accel_step margin first reaches >= 0.1 two or more checkpoints (>= 50 steps) after val_mse_ratio first falls below 1. That would mean probe-readable gravity structure follows the improvement in prediction rather than coming before it. If the two seeds disagree by more than 2 checkpoints, the result is inconclusive.
config.expected_if_true: In both seeds, the first checkpoint where the accel_step margin (R2 - control_R2) is >= 0.1 at some layer is <= the first checkpoint where val_mse_ratio < 1, within a 1-checkpoint (25-step) tolerance. The distance margin crosses 0.1 at or before that point too. The force margin crosses 0.1 no earlier than accel_step.
config.hypothesis: Gravity-related structure forms before or at the same time as the model first beats constant-velocity extrapolation. The accel_step and distance probes beat their random-model controls by >= 0.1 at a checkpoint no later than the first checkpoint where val_mse_ratio < 1.
